content.short: RYO is a modular game engine architecture built on the StarkNet L2 roll-up.
content.description: RYO is a community-driven platform that lets developers build and share modular game components designed to fit within the Dope Wars ecosystem. These modules are designed to be composable, enabling interaction across modules and shared game states. Built on StarkNet, a Layer 2 solution, it offers cheap and efficient computation for experiments and gameplay logic. The project welcomes participation from anyone, and developers can claim the next available number to draft ideas or implement a new module.
